rooms.name: stonework chamber
rooms.description: You are standing in a stonework chamber, fitted with dull grey stone tiles. The room is rectangular in shape and is roughly thirty feet by fifty feet across. The western wall bears this cryptic message: "Speak the element of the guardian of the temple catacombs in the language of spellcraft to gain entrance." The visible exits are south and east through stone archways which stand open to bare stone corridors. There is also a stone archway leading out into the desert to the north.

devices.note: Answer to the west wall riddle. Opens the s and e iron doors together. Reply is "As the answer passes your lips, you feel the floor vibrate faintly." While shut, look says the archways are "fitted with massive iron doors"; once open, "which stand open to bare stone corridors" -- the description carries the seal state.

devices.note: Shrine [S1]. Opens the seal on stonework-corridor-12 <-> stonework-chamber-1 (shrine [D1]). Description names it: "A stone in the northeast wall appears to protrude from the wall slightly more than the others." Reply is "As you push the protruding stone into it's recess, you feel the floor vibrate faintly." -- a REMOTE effect, not a teleport, though `push stone` is the same verb that teleports at [S2]. repeats untested. The seal shows in stonework-corridor-12's description, not in [D1]'s: shut it reads "The corridor continues to the northeast", open "The corridor runs to the northeast and south". [D1] reads the same either way.
